properties.schema-text:
{
  "namespace": "example.avro",
  "type": "record",
  "name": "space_invaders_events",
  "doc": "Matches Hive TIMESTAMP columns: occurred_at and ingest_ts are long epoch-millis (not ISO strings).",
  "fields": [
    {"name": "event_id", "type": "string"},
    {"name": "event_type", "type": "string"},
    {"name": "occurred_at", "type": {"type": "long", "logicalType": "timestamp-millis"}},
    {"name": "session_id", "type": "string"},
    {"name": "player_id", "type": "string"},
    {"name": "player_name", "type": "string"},
    {"name": "game_version", "type": "string"},
    {"name": "level", "type": "int"},
    {"name": "frame", "type": "long"},
    {"name": "data_json", "type": "string"},
    {"name": "ingest_ts", "type": ["null", {"type": "long", "logicalType": "timestamp-millis"}], "default": null}
  ]
}
